object.attr: analysis: review Q3. Without a default a rewrite would have to guess the response to each break: a wrong root element, a missing id or name, a bad span, a missing op. The breaks MELLON-CHECK-SRS gives codes, such as an enum without options, keep the document usable. Decided on 2026-11-10.
object.description: If a data file is well-formed XML but breaks a format rule of MELLON-STORE-SRS that MELLON-CHECK-SRS gives no validation error, Mellon shall report a load error naming the file and the rule.
